scientific_limitations: Exact classification is confined to a positive-weight six-vertex circulant with two noise-free leaders and grounded inverse-trace coherence. No general claim for all vertex-transitive graphs or noisy leaders.
title: A sharp disagreement window between resistance-maximal and coherence-optimal leader pairs
